premises.text: About one third of clothing is returned because it does not fit, and fit requires shape not only size
premises.evidence_span: How can one third of clothing be returned because it doesn't fit?

premises.text: Designers are taught only two of nine body shapes, taking half of women off the design table
premises.evidence_span: They're told to use one of two design body shapes, the hourglass or the rectangle. But these are only two of nine body shapes. This single decision takes half of women off of the design table

premises.text: Shape-filter technology recommends clothing for an individual's body shape and proportion using garment design details
premises.evidence_span: We make recommendations on clothing for an individual body shape and proportion using the design details in an individual garment

premises.text: AI, visual recognition, machine learning, and a shopper UI that captures shape together comprise the shape filter, with a patent-pending knowledge base
premises.evidence_span: Our AI, visual recognition, machine learning, knowledge-based systems classify assortments. Our user interface captures a shopper's shape and her proportion. And these together comprise the shape filter technology

premises.text: Enterprise deals use an annual contract with an upfront fee and a percentage of sales, fitting retailers' inventory systems
premises.evidence_span: We have an annual contract with an upfront fee and a percentage of sales

value.text: Make dressing well ridiculously easy by showing clothes that fit the shopper's body and proportion
value.evidence_span: Savitude is making dressing well ridiculously easy

secondary_value.text: Increase retailer sales and decrease returns
secondary_value.evidence_span: If you want to increase your sales, decrease your returns

causal_links.evidence_span: The problem with returns is more than just a size or a measurement issue. The solution must include shape
